thread:
ryan: PixelCore confirmed early-access units and asked for a short checklist before we accept hardware. They want marketplace packaging and a joint announcement window. Who can own the SKU + listing draft? @anya?
anya: I can draft the marketplace listing. Need: SKU string, supported model flavors, max sequence, quant profiles, and a partner blurb. Does PM want to include performance badges (e.g., low-latency tier)?
jordan: PM prefers only objective metrics: p95 latency at 2k tokens, sustained tokens/sec at 4k, and energy-per-token. No marketing adjectives. Also need a diagram for the listing showing network topology (VPC <> partner gateway).
tess: Ops: lab can accept shipments Tue/Thu only. Carrier preference: DHL express. We'll need a signed chain-of-custody form and serial numbers. Also confirm if partner will preload drivers or want our image.
vikram: Research note: PixelCore's silicon uses an adaptive frequency governor; perf varies a lot under thermal load. We'll plan cold-start runs + 45m soak to capture scaling. Suggest quant profiles: fp16, int8, q4_0. We'll include model variants: redwood/fast-3b and redwood/fast-7b.
alex-pixelcore: We can ship next Mon with drivers preinstalled. We'll attach the test container to a temporary s3 link once NDA is done. Regarding embargo, we prefer a 10-business-day mutual embargo for internal validation, then coordinate a joint blog.
anya: For the SKU I'm thinking PIXCORE-EAP-1 / region:us-west-2. Will draft copy and post a PR to the marketplace repo for review. Who has the asset (logo) from PixelCore? @alex-pixelcore can you share a vector?
alex-pixelcore: Uploading logo and NDA redline here: https://pixelcore-files.s3/nda_redline_v2.pdf and https://pixelcore-files.s3/logo_pixelcore.svg. We'll sign mutual embargo with two-week window if needed.
ryan: Legal: Claire is the legal owner, looping her in offline. Reminder: no PII, and tests must use synthetic prompts. We'll need a short data-handling addendum.
jordan: Integration with SI partners: we need a quickstart doc for systems integrators to validate for on-prem customers. Add steps for network routing and model pinning. Can someone own the SI quickstart?
tess: I can own SI quickstart for lab-to-onprem parity. Will include notes on firewall rules, port ranges, and container runtime settings. Need partner to confirm kernel module versions.
vikram: Bench plan (summary):
- 2 cold runs (cache off) per model/quant
- 1 warm run (cache on) for latency numbers
- 1x 45m soak to observe thermal/frequency behavior
Metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/s sustained, power_draw (W), and max_gpu_temp
Sample command we'll use (repo will have exact harness):
```
python bench.py \\
  --model redwood/fast-7b \\
  --seq 4096 \\
  --batch 1 \\
  --quant q4_0 \\
  --threads 24 \\
  --collect gpu_power,gpu_temp,gpu_freq,mem_bw \\
  --soak 2700 \\
  --prometheus true
```
anya: I'll include the perf badges as raw numbers under "metrics" (not claims). Draft PR will reference the bench repo run-id once we have the artifacts.
ryan: Action items:
- anya: draft marketplace listing + PR with SKU and placeholder metrics (due Thu 1745750000)
- vikram: bench harness + soak plan + parser templates (due Wed 1745710000)
- tess: ship acceptance & SI quickstart doc + chain-of-custody (due Tue 1745695000)
- alex-pixelcore: upload signed NDA and logos, confirm driver/kernel versions (ETA Mon)
- jordan: draft SI outreach note and list of preferred integrators

ryan: I'll set a kickoff call for Mon to align timelines. Thanks all :rocket:
